title: Admissible Brown hypotheses over a field reduce to objectwise compactness
statement: Let ℓ be prime, k a field, X a finite-type k-scheme, and Λ a commutative condensed coefficient ring isomorphic to a finite discrete ℓ-power-torsion ring, Z_l, O_E, Q_l, a finite extension E of Q_l, or finite-subextension-valued Qbar_l, exactly the admissible list [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Put S = Dctf(X,Λ) and L = Loc(S), with the fixed indexing universe. Then BrownHypothesesFor Λ X as characterized by [lem-sfb-brown-hypotheses-criterion] holds if and only if there exists a coproduct structure on L for which every object of L whose underlying object lies in S is compact [def-pc-compact-object]. No separatedness, characteristic, or base-field cohomological-dimension hypothesis is needed for this equivalence. It does not assert compactness over an arbitrary field.

theorem brownHypothesesFor_iff_compact_of_admissible
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (aX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aX] [QuasiCompact aX]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (hΛ :
      (∃ (A : Type) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : TopologicalSpace A)
          (_ : DiscreteTopology A) (_ : IsTopologicalRing A),
        Finite A ∧ (∃ r : ℕ, ∀ a : A, (ℓ ^ r) • a = 0) ∧
          Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj A))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℤ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℚ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ))) :
    BrownHypothesesFor Λ X ↔
      ∃ hSums : HasCoproducts.{u + 1} (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory,
        letI := hSums
        ∀ K : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory,
          (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X K.obj ∧
            DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K.obj) → IsCompactObject K
